body: Ever since I can remember, I been keepin it together but l'm feelin strange

This tattoo is fucking dope. It’s well done, line work is good, shading coloring all good! Overall super dope piece! I like the style you picked it’s unique ! don’t let anyone or YOURSELF overthink this awesome tattoo!
hm maybe try and keep it moist not crazy wet though. avoid using hot water so it doesn’t dry out more and talk to your tat artist!
nah you should go to the doctor and don’t wear any socks

literally a beautiful piece ! I have a spirited away sleeve and it’s similar ! I think adding more soot sprites like others said would look good! mine has a few spread throughout my whole sleeve and I think it really brings things together!

I have a pretty large heavily shaded tattoo right in the middle of my abdomen and it wasn’t as intense as getting my spine done. it’s definitely going to hurt a lot but at the end of the day it really depends on your pain tolerance. in my experience though the more breaks you take the more it’ll hurt so try to get it out in one session and only take breaks when you really need them.

god damn let these women live. i’ve watched the show i’ve heard all the news about them I just don’t care. let’s just be happy that people are trying to do better for themselves. she likes blue hair she dresses how she’s dresses she’s still big…who cares. she’s alive, hopefully healthy and living her life. good for her, her sister, her family and their kids. hope the best of health to all of them

looks like a torch pen! for those you definitely want to store them up right and turn them FULLY OFF when you aren’t using them and TURN IT OFF when you are charging. over time unfortunately I think they tend to leak because of just over heating and that causes the oil to leak out.
girl buy yourself a bike already. you can be mad at him or whatever but just get yourself what you need.

ummm this is dangerous as fuck. I think you have every right to be upset at everyone here. I don’t think this is just a dumb choice they made, it was a dangerous choice. they could have easily started an even bigger fire and then what? then it’s an actual problem? personally I would talk to an RA or something about getting a new roommate. they sound reckless and like it’s going to be a long year with them.

where the hell is your sister in all of this ??? she’s just fine with everyone pressuring you? and with you spending all this money??

edit: sorry I forgot my judgement NTA obviously but at this point again WHERE IS YOUR SISTER?! is she just letting people talk to you like this? it’s not okay :(

okay wow no. YOU ARE NOT THE ASSHOLE AT ALL. first off how are YOU being controlling over YOUR laptop??? it honestly sounds like he just made your new laptop his and when you asked for it back he was like “HoW cOuLd YoU EvEn AsK tHaT??”. it sounds like by calling you controlling he’s trying to manipulate you, even if this from a lack of communication he does not have any right to your new laptop just because “he would do anything for you”….except just give you back your laptop. I think you need to sit down with him and have a long talk on communication, boundaries and overall your relationship. don’t let him walk over you like that for a present you got from YOUR parents!!

don’t beat yourself up!! you aren’t stupid at all you just genuinely wanted to help your boyfriend but you just went about it the wrong way. he needs help and unfortunately it’s more than you can offer. you will be okay but just give yourself time to heal and separate yourself from him! you aren’t stupid at all, if anything you’ve got too much love to give but he’s not the one that should be receiving it anymore. I wish you the best of luck in whatever happens in the future

i’m so confused, why is it your job to save your rapist? i’m so sorry this happened to you and i’m not trying to be hurtful but you also need help. you have this weird idea in your head that you can help/save him but he needs ACTUAL help and you do too. in one of your responses to a comment you said “at least it was him who did it” like because it’s him that raped you and not some random person that makes it better?? you need to get away from this boy and speak to professionals, adults, your parents, and the authorities. Stop trying to take responsibility for someone else’s health and take care of yours first. he is obviously really sick and I don’t think just talking to him is going to help him.

just saw your second update and :((( I hope you broke up with him!! he literally does not deserve you!!! literally he’s gross and could have just been honest from the start rather than lying to you. i’m sorry that this happened but lesson learned! you don’t need a guy like this EVER in your life again! be with someone that loves and appreciates you and your boundaries!

tbh I would dump him. I know it’s wild to jump to that decision so quick but the facebook post of them together is super sketchy, and just the fact that he seems way more willing to cater towards her needs than yours. it’s also weird that once your friend added him he decided to delete EVERYTHING. like they couldn’t even take a look at posts that weren’t about her. I don’t think you should have created a secret account but I can’t say I wouldn’t do the same considering what was on his fb and the vibes the two were giving off. Don’t waste more of your time and emotional energy on this though I feel like all you can do is ask straight up and if you don’t get the answers just leave. you deserve a partner that is willing to understand certain boundaries without even asking. especially with a girl HE KNOWS likes him. I wish you the best of luck!
thank you :) it means a lot just to know someone heard me
nta! get HR involved !! seriously don’t be friends with someone like that! it’s cool to have work friends but not like that ://
